description: This Java source file defines the class 'MqttContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider', which provides logic to extract tenant and authentication ID information from an MQTT context in an Eclipse Hono adapter. It manages tenant identification through certificates or authentication headers, depending on configuration.

classes.name: MqttContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: An implementation of tenant and auth ID provider that extracts information from an MQTT context, supporting certificate-based and header-based authentication, used within the Eclipse Hono MQTT adapter.

methods.name: MqttContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with configuration and tenant client factory.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant object with auth ID from the MQTT context, handling authentication modes (certificates or headers) and unauthenticated scenarios.

methods.name: getTenantViaCert
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info from SSL client certificate if SSL is used.

methods.name: getTenantFromAuthHeader
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info using credentials provided in the MQTT auth header.
